entities.name: RsmB methyltransferase
observations: 436 aa bacterial protein; exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q8PG22 from Xanthomonas citri pv. citri.
Specifically methylates cytosine 967 of 16S rRNA to form m5C967.
Annotated as cytoplasmic RNA-binding rRNA cytosine-C5 methyltransferase, EC 2.1.1.176.
Pfam architecture: NusB PF01029 at residues 12-133, RsmF-B_ferredox PF22458 at 145-217, and Methyltr_RsmB-F PF01189 at 241-432.
Sequence-derived properties: 436 aa, approximately 47.0 kDa, theoretical pI 7.67, near-neutral charge at pH 7.

entities.name: 16S rRNA C967 methylation
observations: Cytidine 967 in 16S rRNA is methylated using S-adenosyl-L-methionine, producing 5-methylcytidine, S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine, and H+; EC 2.1.1.176; Rhea RHEA:42748.
